name: Bitexco Skydeck
summary: Skydeck on the 49th floor: ride up for the river and the city, open 9:30–21:30. The entrance is at 02 Hai Triều, Saigon Ward. An adult ticket is 240,000 đồng. Last tickets are 45 minutes before closing. The deck sits at 178 metres. Leave food and drink downstairs.
getThere: Walk from Nguyễn Huệ toward the river, to 02 Hai Triều.
heroCaption: The full Bitexco shaft and the round deck, from the street

notice.title: Last entry is 45 minutes early
notice.body: The deck is open 9:30–21:30 every day. Last tickets and last entry are 45 minutes before closing. Food and drink stay downstairs.

body: Saigon Skydeck is on the 49th floor of Bitexco Financial Tower. The entrance is at 02 Hai Triều, Saigon Ward. The operator puts the deck at 178 metres, with a full turn of the city and the Saigon River. Buy the ticket at the counter. A ticket is one entry, and it is not resold or refunded.

An adult pays 240,000 đồng. A child from 4 to 12, a senior over 65, and a disabled visitor pay 160,000 đồng. A child under 4 is free with an adult, in a limited number. The operator can change the price and the hours without a prior notice, so read the board at the ticket office. The photograph is the whole tower and the round deck. The second frame is the same shaft from another side, with the flag.

figures.caption: The tower from another side, with the round deck and the flag
figures.alt: Bitexco Financial Tower and its round deck from the side

gettingThere: The entrance is at 02 Hai Triều, Saigon Ward, a walk from Nguyễn Huệ toward the river. Minutes on foot were not printed. From Bạch Đằng the tower is the shaft beside the quay.

legs.heading: From Nguyễn Huệ
legs.body: Walk toward the river to 02 Hai Triều. The minutes were not printed.

legs.heading: From Bạch Đằng
legs.body: The quay looks straight at the tower. The station is at 10B Tôn Đức Thắng.

hours: 9:30–21:30 every day. Last tickets and last entry are 45 minutes before closing.
closed: No weekly closing day is printed.
admissionNote: Adult 240,000 VND. Child 4–12, senior over 65, and disabled visitor 160,000 VND. Child under 4 free with an adult, limited number. One entry. Food and drink are not allowed on the deck. The operator may change the price and the hours without prior notice.
